items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: Willie Paggio, George Lewis and Harold Dejon and all that bunch. We were Paggio's band

ctx.x: Didn't you have a list of questions about that? Yeah, I wanted to ask you some more about other people named Lewis, you know. Who, George Lewis? Yeah, are you akin to anybody else named Lewis? I just-

No, no. I played with George Lewis and Willie Paggio. Willie Paggio, George Lewis and Harold Dejon and all that bunch. We were Paggio's band and at some time we, I was supposed to go with George Lewis. And I was playing with George Lewis just before he, you know, he'd taken a sequel, he decided not to run all of them down the road, but he was playing spot jobs, you know, when he felt up to it here in town, because I was supposed to go. We didn't know a relation at all. We could be distant cousins. I don't know…
but I was playing with him. I just wanted, because it seemed to be a dozen musicians named Lewis.
